settings.heading: Overview
settings.body:
A small footprint, quiet vacuum pump typically used to provide vacuum for wafer chucks and manipulators. Where a probe station has no house vacuum available, this pump supplies the hold-down for vacuum chucks and vacuum-base manipulators.

Each pump ships with the connector, tubing and a power cord — a USA three prong plug on the 115 V unit, or a European two prong plug on the 230 V unit.

settings.question: Which electrical type should I order?
settings.answer: Order the 115 V / 60 Hz unit for USA mains, which ships with a three prong USA power cord, or the 230 V / 50 Hz unit for European mains, which ships with a two prong Euro cord.

settings.question: What does the pump come with?
settings.answer: Each pump ships with the connector, tubing and the power cord for the selected region, so it can be connected to a chuck or manipulator on arrival.

settings.question: Do I need a pump if my lab has house vacuum?
settings.answer: No. These pumps are for stations without house vacuum, or where a dedicated, independent supply is preferred for the chuck or manipulator.

settings.question: Can one pump run a chuck and a manipulator together?
settings.answer: It depends on the number of vacuum points and the hold-down each needs. Tell us your chuck size and how many vacuum-base manipulators you are running and we will confirm before you order.

settings.heading: Building a Complete Probing Station?
settings.body: SemiProbe supplies the vacuum, air and fixturing around your probe system — pumps, compressors, chucks and part holders specified together so the station works as one.
